newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Aug 26.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Aug 26.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers on Monday firmed slightly, tracking healthy paper quotes, brokers said. Seller's quotes came off from earlier highs as buyers stood back from market. Bunker 380-cst prices were eventually quoted between $105-$108 and 180-cst at $110-$112. MDO was also higher at $186-$191, up from $184/$189. Gasoil was unchanged at $200-$205.
